scope: Recovered engine context and input service startup, primary/VMU discovery and game system setup connect to native backend work pool/object initialization, work posting and context scheduling. Full retail RAM/CPU/FPU/special-register comparisons. Independent manager pointer, work count, posted context and stack/entry checks. Executes backend request from scheduled context and returns to manager after yielding. Request arguments explicitly supplied by test. No constructed manager/context records in this test. Device responses and hardware behavior remain synthetic; Request completes and resumes via explicit native context-restore call; automatic manager wakeup is not covered.
